panels.title: Plant weight — every weighing, at the time it happened
panels.description: Raw readings plotted where they actually fall in time, not bucketed into days. Weighing happens when someone is free, not on a schedule, and a pot also drifts through the day with the plant's own respiration — so a daily bucket imposed a grid the measurements do not have and hid both effects. A watering shows here as a step up, drying as the slope between steps.

panels.title: Water use rate (g/day) — normalised for the gap between weighings
panels.description: Weight lost per 24 hours, computed between consecutive weighings and divided by the actual elapsed time — so a 19-hour gap and a 3-day gap are directly comparable. Positive means the plant drank it. Pairs less than an hour apart are excluded: those are the same session, not an interval. ⚠ Still read with care — the changes are a few grams on pots of 130-2200 g, and the 2026-08-06 session appears to carry a systematic offset of about -6 g. Use mark-weight.sh to label a session suspect and it will drop out of every chart.

panels.title: Water added (g) — measured, and estimated where the pre-water weighing is missing
panels.description: Solid bars: both weighings came from the same session, so the jump is the water and nothing else. Faded bars: no pre-water reading that session, so the pair spans a gap and the value is water added minus what the plant used in between — and across a gap real waterings and mere drift overlap in size (largest drift seen +13.0 g, smallest watering caught this way +20.2 g). Two series rather than one number because the two are not equally trustworthy. A day with no bar is a day nothing was watered.

targets.query:
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Taipei")

from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "plant_weight" and r._field == "weight_g")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.quality == "ok" and r.plant_id != "unknown")
  |> group(columns: ["plant_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with w: r._value, t: float(v: int(v: r._time)) }))
  |> difference(columns: ["w", "t"], nonNegative: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with hours: r.t / 3600000000000.0, _value: r.w }))
  // MEASURED: both weighings are from the same session, so the jump is the water
  // and nothing else. Observed here: repeat weighings of an untouched pot differ
  // by 1.8 g, every real watering is 19.5 g or more — a clean gap, so 5 g
  // separates them with room to spare.
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.hours < 1.0 and r._value > 5.0)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "plant_id"])
  |> yield(name: "measured")

panels.title: 介質狀態 — 本次飽和重量 vs 先前場次（主指標），加水量為輔
panels.description:
介質狀態：以**澆水後的飽和重量**為主指標（不是加水量）。

為什麼不用加水量當主指標：加水量約等於「澆水當下的缺水量」，取決於距上次澆水的天數與蒸散強度 —— 同樣的介質，晚兩天澆就會多加水。它衡量的是澆水行為，不是持水能力。澆水後的飽和重量才接近「這個盆能裝多少」。加水量欄位保留作為異常／行為指標。

**混淆因子**：飽和重量同時包含植株本身的生長。介質流失使它下降、植株生長使它上升，兩者方向相反可能互相抵消。仙人掌生長極慢，流失應該主導，但一條持平的曲線不能直接解釋為「介質沒問題」。

基準 = 先前合格澆水場次的中位數（最多取最近 3 次）。中位數而非平均，是為了對單一異常場次穩健。**n 欄必看**：n=1 時這只是兩點相減，不是趨勢。

「場次」= 當日有 ≥50%(≥8/16) 植株增重 >10 g 的日子；未達此標準的日子列在「疑似異常場次」表中，不併入統計。

⚠ 秤重系統的重複性至今**沒有被量過**（唯一一批固定重量讀數取自重新佈線後、校正前，量到的是施工中的機器）。本表提供的是相對比較與排序，不是可信到克的絕對值。

targets.query:
import "date"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Taipei")

src = from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: -90d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "plant_weight" and r._field == "weight_g"
       and r.quality == "ok" and r.plant_id != "tare-ref" and r.plant_id != "unknown")

deltas = src
  |> group(columns: ["plant_id"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> difference(columns: ["_value"], nonNegative: false)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 10.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with day: date.truncate(t: r._time, unit: 1d) }))

// 合格澆水場次 = 當日 >=50% (>=8/16) 植株增重
sessDays = deltas
  |> group(columns: ["day", "plant_id"]) |> distinct(column: "plant_id")
  |> group(columns: ["day"]) |> count(column: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value >= 8)
  |> group() |> keep(columns: ["day"])

dayArr = sessDays |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "day")
S = (sessDays |> sort(columns: ["day"]) |> last(column: "day")
      |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)).day

// 每株 × 每個合格場次：飽和重量、加水量、步數
sat = src
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with day: date.truncate(t: r._time, unit: 1d) }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.day, set: dayArr))
  |> group(columns: ["plant_id", "day"]) |> max()
  |> group(columns: ["plant_id"]) |> keep(columns: ["plant_id", "day", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "sat"})

add = deltas
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.day, set: dayArr))
  |> group(columns: ["plant_id", "day"])
  |> reduce(identity: {add: 0.0, steps: 0}, fn: (r, accumulator) =>
       ({ add: accumulator.add + r._value, steps: accumulator.steps + 1 }))
  |> group(columns: ["plant_id"]) |> keep(columns: ["plant_id", "day", "add", "steps"])

per = join(tables: {s: sat, a: add}, on: ["plant_id", "day"])

this_s = per |> filter(fn: (r) => r.day == S)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ plant_id: r.plant_id, sat_now: r.sat, add_now: r.add, steps: float(v: r.steps) }))
  |> group()

prior = per |> filter(fn: (r) => r.day < S)
  |> group(columns: ["plant_id"]) |> sort(columns: ["day"], desc: true) |> limit(n: 3)

p_sat = prior |> group(columns: ["plant_id"]) |> median(column: "sat")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ plant_id: r.plant_id, k: "sat_base", v: r.sat })) |> group()
p_add = prior |> group(columns: ["plant_id"]) |> median(column: "add")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ plant_id: r.plant_id, k: "add_base", v: r.add })) |> group()
p_n = prior |> group(columns: ["plant_id"]) |> count(column: "sat")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ plant_id: r.plant_id, k: "n", v: float(v: r.sat) })) |> group()

base = union(tables: [p_sat, p_add, p_n]) |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["plant_id"], columnKey: ["k"], valueColumn: "v")

join(tables: {t: this_s, b: base}, on: ["plant_id"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
       plant_id: r.plant_id,
       sat_now: r.sat_now, sat_base: r.sat_base,
       sat_diff: r.sat_now - r.sat_base,
       sat_pct: (r.sat_now - r.sat_base) / r.sat_base * 100.0,
       add_now: r.add_now, add_base: r.add_base,
       steps: r.steps, n: r.n }))
  |> sort(columns: ["sat_pct"])
  |> keep(columns: ["plant_id","sat_now","sat_base","sat_diff","sat_pct","add_now","add_base","steps","n"])

panels.title: 該澆水了嗎 — 耗竭程度（分母為觀測範圍，非真實持水量）
panels.description:
現在該澆哪一盆。依耗竭程度排序。

耗竭% = (飽和 − 現在) / (飽和 − 乾基準) × 100。
‧ 飽和 = 最近一次合格澆水場次之後的最大重量（錨定日期欄可見）。
‧ 乾基準 = 60 天內的第 10 百分位，**不是最小值** —— 單一錯誤的低讀數會撐大分母、壓低耗竭%，而這類雜訊已知存在。

**兩個判準的差別只在門檻，分母相同**：
‧「依你的習慣」= 耗竭 ≥100%，即已達你歷史上實際會澆水的乾度。
‧「達觀測範圍80%」= 耗竭 ≥80%，提早提醒。

⚠ 分母是**你用過的重量範圍**，不是真實的容器持水量 —— 乾介質重量從未量測。因此這裡的百分比不具備園藝上「土壤含水耗竭%」的意義，不要那樣解讀。取得真實乾基重（空盆+全乾介質）之後，分母才能換成真正的持水量。

⚠「依你的習慣」是**描述性的，不是規範性的**：它只記錄你過去會在多乾時澆水。若你因為看了這張表而提早澆水，乾基準就不再更新，門檻會凍結在舊習慣上。行為改變後這個基準需要重新檢視。

⚠ 錨點來自全域場次。若只澆單盆，該盆的實際飽和點會比錨點新，本表會低估其含水量 —— 「錨定日期」與「距上次澆水」兩欄使這個失效可見。

targets.query:
import "date"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Taipei")

src = (start) => from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: start)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "plant_weight" and r._field == "weight_g"
       and r.quality == "ok" and r.plant_id != "tare-ref" and r.plant_id != "unknown")

// --- 錨點：最近一個「>=50% 植株增重」的日子（不是最後一筆 >10g 差值）---
S = (src(start: -90d)
  |> group(columns: ["plant_id"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> difference(columns: ["_value"], nonNegative: false)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 10.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with day: date.truncate(t: r._time, unit: 1d) }))
  |> group(columns: ["day", "plant_id"]) |> distinct(column: "plant_id")
  |> group(columns: ["day"]) |> count(column: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value >= 8)
  |> group() |> sort(columns: ["day"]) |> last(column: "day")
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)).day

nowW = src(start: -90d) |> group(columns: ["plant_id"]) |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ plant_id: r.plant_id, k: "now", v: r._value }))
satW = src(start: -90d) |> range(start: S) |> group(columns: ["plant_id"]) |> max()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ plant_id: r.plant_id, k: "sat", v: r._value }))
dryW = src(start: -60d) |> group(columns: ["plant_id"])
  |> quantile(q: 0.1, method: "exact_mean")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ plant_id: r.plant_id, k: "dry", v: r._value }))

union(tables: [nowW, satW, dryW]) |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["plant_id"], columnKey: ["k"], valueColumn: "v")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with span: r.sat - r.dry }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.span > 5.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
       plant_id: r.plant_id,
       now_g: r.now, sat_g: r.sat, dry_g: r.dry,
       depl_pct: (r.sat - r.now) / r.span * 100.0,
       days: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: S)) / 86400000000000.0 }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with
       habit: if r.depl_pct >= 100.0 then "● 該澆水" else "○",
       obs80: if r.depl_pct >= 80.0 then "● 該澆水" else "○" }))
  |> sort(columns: ["depl_pct"], desc: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["plant_id","now_g","sat_g","dry_g","depl_pct","habit","obs80","days"])

panels.title: 疑似異常場次 — 增重株數未達門檻者已排除統計
panels.description:
pipeline 誤差的觀測窗。

列出所有「有植株增重 >10 g」的日子，以及當天有幾株。澆水是全體同時發生的事件（16 株約在 26 分鐘內完成），所以：
‧ ≥8 株 → 判定為澆水場次，納入統計。
‧ 1–7 株 → 判定為疑似異常，**排除**在統計之外，但列在這裡讓你看見。

為什麼需要這張表：2026-08-10 有 7 株同時增重、08-11 有 1 株。這些不是澆水，但若直接當成澆水事件納入基準，會嚴重扭曲比較結果（實測會使某株的比較失真成 +321%）。把它們排除但顯示出來，比靜默丟棄誠實。

注意：百分比門檻無法取代這個判定 —— 08-10 的 cactus-07 增重 15.1 g 佔其盆重 10.9%，與真實澆水的比例重疊。全域同時性才是有效的判別依據。

targets.query:
import "date"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Taipei")

jumps = from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: -90d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "plant_weight" and r._field == "weight_g"
       and r.quality == "ok" and r.plant_id != "tare-ref" and r.plant_id != "unknown")
  |> group(columns: ["plant_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> difference(columns: ["_value"], nonNegative: false)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 10.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with day: date.truncate(t: r._time, unit: 1d) }))

counts = jumps
  |> group(columns: ["day", "plant_id"]) |> distinct(column: "plant_id")
  |> group(columns: ["day"]) |> count(column: "_value")
  |> group() |> rename(columns: {_value: "n_plants"})

names = jumps
  |> group(columns: ["day", "plant_id"]) |> distinct(column: "plant_id")
  |> group(columns: ["day"]) |> sort(columns: ["_value"])
  |> reduce(identity: {who: ""}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
       who: if accumulator.who == "" then r._value else accumulator.who + ", " + r._value }))
  |> group()

join(tables: {c: counts, n: names}, on: ["day"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
       day: r.day,
       n_plants: r.n_plants,
       verdict: if r.n_plants >= 8 then "澆水場次" else "疑似異常 — 已排除",
       who: r.who }))
  |> sort(columns: ["day"], desc: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["day", "n_plants", "verdict", "who"])

panels.title: DLI per day (lux estimate)
panels.description: Daily light integral from the BH1750, lux/54. This is the figure the light controller tops up against (DLI_TARGET, default 4.0), so it is the one to read when asking whether the evening top-up did its job. Absolute scale is not trustworthy — lux/54 is a daylight conversion applied to an LED — so read it relatively.

targets.query:
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Taipei")

from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "air" and r._field == "lux" and r.device == "livingroom")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 54.0 }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: (tables=<-, column) => tables |> integral(unit: 1s), createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 1000000.0 }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> yield(name: "DLI lux est.")

panels.title: Outdoor solar & rain per day (板橋)
panels.description: Open-Meteo daily context. Indoor light barely tracks this — natural light measured at 1-2% of the indoor daily total on 2026-07-30 — so treat it as weather context, not as an explanation of indoor DLI.

targets.query:
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Taipei")

from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r._field == "shortwave_radiation")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> yield(name: "solar mean")

import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Taipei")

from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r._field == "precipitation")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> yield(name: "rain total")

panels.title: Alert delivery failures per hour — did the warnings actually reach you?
panels.description: Notifications Grafana tried to send and could not. Every other panel here answers a question about the plants; this one answers whether you would have been TOLD. On 2026-08-08 delivery to Telegram failed 89 times over five hours while the deadman was firing correctly, and a 53-hour sensor outage went unnoticed for two days as a result. With a single notification channel you cannot be alerted that the channel is down — so this makes it permanent, reviewable data instead. Flat zero is healthy. Any bar means alerts were raised and never arrived: go and look at what was firing in that window.

targets.query:
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Taipei")

// Counter, so take the difference — and nonNegative because a Grafana restart
// resets it to zero, which would otherwise read as a huge negative spike.
from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "grafana_alerting_notifications_failed_total")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "counter")
  |> group(columns: ["integration"])
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "integration"])

panels.title: Lamp — when it switched off each day
panels.description: Local hour of the last lamp-off. 18.5 = the base window end (18:30, no top-up); ~19.8-20.1 = the evening top-up ran and reached DLI_TARGET; 20.5 = it ran to the EXTEND_END cap without reaching target, i.e. the lamp delivered less light than usual that day. Restricted to 17:00-21:30 because light/state is retained and every Telegraf reconnect replays it as a phantom OFF.

panels.title: Ingest completeness — points per day
panels.description: Points stored per day per pipeline. This is the panel that makes a silent outage visible: the Open-Meteo 503 collapse shows here as weather dropping from ~96/day to 3-10/day between 2026-07-30 and 08-03, and the recovery back to 96 after the poll interval was cut to 5 min. A pipeline going flat is the signal — the absolute heights differ by design.
